$comment: Read by scripts/harvest-cropontology.mjs and scripts/build.mjs. `include` is a regex on ontologyDbId; only matching ontologies are harvested and published. Display names are the upstream ontologyName with `stripWords` removed (whole words, case-insensitive), unless `names` overrides them by id. The original name is kept in additionalInfo.sourceOntologyName. `planteomePaths` lists extra files (repo-relative) to copy from a Planteome repo when its trait data is not at the root; `planteomeFiles` picks the file to compare when a repo has several. `siteReloadsCountFrom`: cropontology.org reloads before this date (its 2023 migration re-imported old content) do not count as newer than GitHub. `traitClasses` standardises trait class names. `sources` forces which copy wins when the two disagree.

traitClasses.$comment: Trait class names are standardised so one class isn't listed under several spellings (e.g. wheat's "Phenological traits" and "Phenological"). Each part of a class ("Quality/Aroma" has two) that matches an `aliases` key or a `standard` class, ignoring case and a trailing "trait" or "traits", is spelled as the alias target or standard class; every part then starts with a capital letter. `regroup` then moves a crop's one-off classes into the common ones, by ontology ID and the class name as spelled after those rules (keys match case-insensitively). The source value is kept in the trait's additionalInfo.sourceTraitClass.

knownBroken.CO_356: cropontology.org returns HTTP 500 for /brapi/v2/variables?ontologyDbId=CO_356 (and v1) at any page size, though every variable loads on its own via ?observationVariableDbId=. Likely cause: 9 scales (37 variables) have categories stored as dates by Excel, e.g. '1-2-3' became 2003-01-02T00:00:00. No other ontology has non-text categories. Found 2026-11-18.

Its trait dictionary is in Planteome/CO_369-sainfoin-traits on GitHub but hasn't been loaded into the site. Found 2026-11-18.
